estonia.title: „Putin nu are intenţia de a ataca teritoriul NATO” dă asigurări Donald Trump, care spune că va vorbi cu liderul rus
estonia.description: Donald Trump a spus din nou vineri că liderul rus Vladimir Putin „nu are intenţia de a ataca” NATO, după ce Germania a acuzat Moscova că a trimis o dronă încărcată cu explozibili la începutul lunii august la aeroportul din Leipzig, relatează AFP.

estonia.title: Sabotajul rusesc în Europa: cât de aproape suntem de un incident ce poate declanșa criza NATO
estonia.description: Atacul eșuat al Rusiei cu drone asupra unui aeroport german a făcut parte dintr-un model periculos de escaladare care, potrivit experților și oficialilor, riscă să declanșeze o confruntare deschisă cu NATO, indiferent dacă Kremlinul dorește acest lucru sau nu, scrie The New York Times.

estonia.title: Cum au ajuns datele de publicitate online o armă împotriva trupelor SUA din Orientul Mijlociu. Măsura radicală a armatei
estonia.description: Oficialii armatei SUA afirmă că au dezactivat sistemele de urmărire pentru publicitate online (ad trackers, n.r) pe o serie de telefoane și computere, potrivit unor scrisori, publicate vineri de senatorul american Ron Wyden și declarațiilor oferite agenției Reuters, o evoluție care vine în urma unor rapoarte conform cărora datele de localizare disponibile pe piață au fost utilizate pentru a ținti forțele americane din Orientul Mijlociu.

estonia.title: Nicușor Dan, mesaj pentru Giorgia Meloni după ce guvernul italian a stabilit un record de longevitate
estonia.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a transmis, vineri, un mesaj pentru premierul italian Giorgia Meloni, după ce guvernul condus de aceasta a devenit cel mai longeviv din istoria Republicii Italiene. Acesta a felicitat-o pe Meloni și a subliniat relațiile strânse dintre România și Italia, precum și interesele comune ale celor două țări în cadrul Uniunii Europene și NATO. Mesajul șefului statului vine în contextul în care România nu are un Guvern de patru luni, după demiterea prin moțiune de cenzură a Cabintului Bolojan.

estonia.title: Ambasada Moscovei la București: „Ameninţarea la adresa României nu vine din Rusia, ci din respectarea directivelor NATO și UE”
estonia.description: Ambasada Rusiei la București a publicat vineri o declaraţie de presă în urma convocării ambasadorului Vladimir Lipaev la Ministerul de Externe, în care califică drept „absurde” acuzaţiile Germaniei privind implicarea Rusiei în incidentul cu dronă pe aeroportul din Leipzig. Reprezentanța diplomatică a Moscovei mai afirmă, de asemenea, că „ameninţarea la adresa securităţii României” nu vine din Rusia, ci din „respectarea nechibzuită a directivelor de politică externă a aripii agresive NATO și UE”.

estonia.title: Ambasadorul Gavin Buchan: „Oamenii înțeleg acum că securitatea Mării Negre este securitatea flancului estic al NATO”
estonia.description: Canada este tot mai apropiată de Europa, pentru că valorile comune se recunosc uşor în lumea care se transformă. Securitatea continentului european este de interes pentru canadieni, iar Marea Neagră, cel mai fierbinte punct de pe flancul estic, este zona care îi ţine atenţi. Ambasadorul Gavin Buchan şi-a încheiat misiunea diplomatică în România, dar nu înainte să dea, la emisiunea Pașaport Diplomatic, mai multe detalii despre ce urmează în relaţia România-Canada.

estonia.title: INTERVIU „Până acum am avut secete reci, astăzi avem secete fierbinți”. Cum au dezvăluit stejarii cel mai secetos an din ultimele opt secole
estonia.description: Un grup de cercetători români a reconstituit opt secole de climă în România folosind  inelele de creștere ale stejarilor, completate cu cronici vechi. Coordonatorul acestei cercetări, profesorul Cătălin-Constantin Roibu de la Universitate Ștefan cel Mare din Suceava, vorbește, într-un interviu pentru publicul HotNews, despre evenimentele climatice extreme ale ultimilor 800 de ani, descoperite după ce …

estonia.title: Tiit Hennoste: This lying, lying, lying world
estonia.description: People are still driven by Vanity, Envy, Fame, Convenience, Money and Power. Unfortunately, it is impossible to make any of them disappear, writes Tiit Hennoste, originally in Sirp magazine.

estonia.title: Former chief: Office of the President must maintain institutional memory
estonia.description: Institutional memory and experienced staff are crucial at Kadriorg, particularly during a presidential transition, when a new head of state must be ready to perform their duties from day one, Siim Raie tells ERR in an interview.

estonia.title: Experiment: How easy is it to buy a research paper on the black market?
estonia.description: Paper mills are making it easier than ever for researchers to buy authorship of bogus academic papers, fueling concerns that mounting pressure to publish is undermining research integrity.

estonia.title: Lavly Perling: Let's not live in dreams
estonia.description: The lives of Estonian people will not be improved by Kristen Michal's sugar‑coating nor by Urmas Reinsalu's populism, writes Lavly Perling.

estonia.title: Being transferred from one hospital to another restarts inpatient fee count
estonia.description: Under Estonian law, a hospital may charge a patient an inpatient fee for a maximum of 10 days per case. However, if the patient is transferred from one hospital to another, the 10-day period starts over.

estonia.title: Dog Pennu finds a home after 1,497 days in Tartu shelter
estonia.description: This spring, the dog Pennu, who had lived for more than four years at the Tartu shelter for homeless animals, found his real home.

estonia.title: Gallery: The youth film 'Morten' premiered at Kosmos cinema
estonia.description: On Friday evening, director Ivan Pavljutškov's feature‑length directorial debut "Morten" premiered at Kosmos cinema in Tallinn. The film is based on Estonian writer Reeli Reinaus' award‑winning youth novel "Morten, Emilie ja kadunud maailmad" (Morten, Emilie and the Lost Worlds).

estonia.title: Ninth Station Narva festival underway in Narva
estonia.description: The annual music and city festival Station Narva began in Narva on Friday, bringing well‑known performers from Estonia and abroad to the border city for a weekend of concerts and events.

estonia.title: Mart Võrklaev: How Estonia's public finances reached their current state
estonia.description: It is extremely cynical to hear concern about budget balance from those who themselves have been the architects of irresponsible decisions, writes Mart Võrklaev in response to Jüri Ratas' commentary "Growth bought with state debt will clip future prosperity."

estonia.title: Photos: Pärnu continues flood recovery as crews pump out water
estonia.description: In the city of Pärnu, work continued on Saturday to eliminate the consequences of the flooding that hit the city on Friday, with the most critical situation in the beach district and the Rääma neighborhood.

estonia.title: Police to keep assisting fallen seniors outside working hours
estonia.description: The Ministry of the Interior has changed its initial decision, under which police officers would no longer have to go help elderly people who have fallen at home, leaving this to ambulance crews and social workers, and has now announced that it will temporarily continue providing this assistance outside working hours.

estonia.title: Presidential office director laid off 13 staff over two years
estonia.description: Office of the President Director Krista Zibo has laid off 13 staff members over the past two years, with two protocol advisers departing this Friday — barely a month before the new president takes office. Zibo herself recently secured a permanent contract.

estonia.title: Video: Emergency situation declared in Pärnu after heavy rain floods streets
estonia.description: A crisis situation was declared Friday in Pärnu after record rainfall — described as the rain of the century — caused widespread flooding, overwhelmed sewers and forced school closures.

estonia.title: More than 400 caravans gather in Obinitsa for annual meet
estonia.description: In Obinitsa, Setomaa municipality, the Estonian Caravan Club's 34th motorhome gathering is taking place. More than 400 caravans with nearly a thousand participants have rolled in.

estonia.title: Longer exclusion orders cut domestic violence repeats, police say
estonia.description: New rules on barring perpetrators of domestic abuse from re‑entry to their homes for up to 72 hours have led to a fall in repeat offenses, police say.

estonia.title: Jüri Ratas: Growth bought with state debt will clip future prosperity
estonia.description: Don't believe the coalition's latest assurances that taxes won't rise again or that the budget will magically balance thanks to some mysterious internal reserves. Budget arithmetic clearly shows these promises won't hold, writes Jüri Ratas.

estonia.title: State to order shelter plans for up to 400 buildings
estonia.description: Riigi Kinnisvara (RKAS) is ordering shelter plans and proposals for how rooms could be adapted for up to 400 buildings, and the expected cost is €520,000.

estonia.title: Eesti Post put up for sale at €52 million starting price
estonia.description: On Friday, the Ministry of Regional Affairs and Agriculture announced a public written auction for the disposal of shares of the public limited company Eesti Post. The deadline for submitting bids is 27 November. The auction will sell 100 percent of Eesti Post's shares, with a total starting price of €52 million.

estonia.title: Study: Estonia's climate warming 1.5 times faster than global average
estonia.description: Estonia's average air temperature is set to rise by 1.5 degrees Celsius for every 1 degree Celsius of global warming, University of Tartu researchers found.

estonia.title: MoD official: Russia has shifted to round-the-clock strike tactics in Ukraine
estonia.description: Russia has shifted its long‑range strike tactics against Ukraine, moving from dense nighttime barrages to longer, round‑the‑clock attacks with fewer strike assets, said Gert Kaju, head of the Ministry of Defense's readiness department.

estonia.title: Ingrid Neel and partner cruise past seeded pair in US Open round one
estonia.description: Estonian tennis player Ingrid Neel and her partner Giuliana Olmos (Mexico) made a winning start to the US Open women's doubles tournament, beating the 11th‑seeded pair Shuko Aoyama and Liang En‑shuo in straight sets.

estonia.title: Estonia fuel prices swing daily as retailer price war becomes 'new norm'
estonia.description: Fuel prices in Estonia are now fluctuating daily or even several times a day, driven more by an ongoing price war between filling station chains than by the Iran crisis.

estonia.title: Estonia terminates Ukraine arms deals worth over €71 million, pursues court cases
estonia.description: The Estonian Center for Defense Investments (RKIK) has so far concluded 27 contracts intended to purchase weapons or ammunition for Ukraine. Of the 27 contracts, seven have been terminated, and RKIK has already taken five of them to court.

estonia.title: Employers' leader urges Estonia to model its economic policy on the U.S.
estonia.description: Estonia should look to the United States for inspiration when building its economic environment, says Ain Hanschmidt, president of the Estonian Employers' Confederation.

estonia.title: Former EDF commander offered defense minister post
estonia.description: Former Estonian Defense Forces (EDF) commander General Martin Herem has been offered the defense minister post by Prime Minister Kristen Michal, Herem told ERR.

estonia.title: Industrial production up by 2.3% in July, led by wood and machinery
estonia.description: Total industrial production rose by 2.3 percent at constant prices year‑on‑year in July, Statistics Estonia reported, with growth across all three sectors.

estonia.title: EDF chief criticized for media comments on defense minister's resignation
estonia.description: Estonian military chief Lt. Gen. Andrus Merilo drew fire for saying outgoing Defense Minister Hanno Pevkur (Reform) should have stayed in office until the next elections.

estonia.title: Estonia taking two more defense firms to court over contracts
estonia.description: The state Center for Defense Investments (RKIK) is taking two more defense firms to court over payment and delivery issues.

estonia.title: Harri Tiido: Former U.S. intelligence officer on Russian espionage
estonia.description: This time, with the help of Sean Wiswesser, we take a closer look at Russian intelligence methods. As sending their own officers abroad and relying on long-term agents has become more difficult, Russian intelligence increasingly uses one-time and unstable sources, Harri Tiido writes.

estonia.title: Kuressaare Airport runway reopens as renovations completed
estonia.description: The runway at Kuressaare Airport on Saaremaa has reopened to aircraft and passengers after three weeks' closure for an upgrade.

estonia.title: Teacher says winning teens' attention is a daily battle in literature class
estonia.description: Writer and Tabasalu High School literature teacher Jürgen Rooste says that teaching is often a daily struggle for students' attention, but some encounters and moments also give a great deal of energy.

estonia.title: Teen actor to play Bolt founder Markus Villig in upcoming movie
estonia.description: A feature film about the founding of Estonian startup Bolt is currently under production, with 16‑year‑old actor Tõru Kannimäe cast in the lead role as founder Markus Villig.

estonia.title: Estonia condemns Russia over Leipzig airport drone attack
estonia.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Wednesday summoned Russia's chargé d'affaires to express its strong condemnation of last month's drone incidents at a German airport.

estonia.title: Liina Gross: People need to be aware of how forests are managed
estonia.description: Less exposure to forestry means less knowledge of the field and less interest in studying, working or starting a business in the sector, Liina Gross writes.

estonia.title: Lihtsad uudised 4. septembril
estonia.description: "Lihtsad uudised," meaning easy or simple news, is for anyone who wants to improve their Estonian language skills. Listen and read a selection of this week's news stories below.

estonia.title: Fraud victims often trust scammers instead of the police
estonia.description: Scam victims increasingly hang up on real police officers, convinced they're speaking to fraudsters, says Valmar Viitak, head of the Northern Prefecture's serious‑crimes unit.

estonia.title: One-third of students have special educational needs and require support
estonia.description: The number of children with special educational needs has grown, and they now make up a third of all students. Schools should provide support for these children, and universities and employers are increasingly able to accommodate their needs.

estonia.title: Last summer in Estonia was warmer than usual
estonia.description: According to the Environment Agency, the average air temperature last summer was 16.8 degrees Celsius.

estonia.title: AI discovers thousands of overlooked field islands in Estonia
estonia.description: Researchers at the University of Tartu have used artificial intelligence (AI) to automatically locate field islands across Estonia and discovered around 10,000 more of them than are listed in the official register.

estonia.title: Natural gas price hits €75 per MWh, matching 2022 crisis levels
estonia.description: European gas prices have surged to €75 per megawatt‑hour, reaching levels not seen since the 2022 energy crisis, with further rises possibly on the way.

estonia.title: Kuressaare residents told to boil water after E. coli, coliform found
estonia.description: Coliform bacteria were found across the water network in Kuressaare, Saaremaa's capital, while E. coli was found in two samples. Residents are advised to boil drinking water.

estonia.title: Man sentenced to life for torture killing of young couple
estonia.description: The Harju District Court found Ruslan Garafutdinov and Igor Popov guilty of murdering two young people in a manner involving torture and to conceal another crime. Garafutdinov was sentenced to life imprisonment.

estonia.title: Patient health data leaked from dentists' information system
estonia.description: At the end of August, Innovaatik — the company providing information‑system services to dental‑care providers — notified the police that their managed computer system had been repeatedly accessed illegally and patient personal data, including health data, had been downloaded. On Wednesday, police detained a 45‑year‑old Estonian citizen as a suspect.

estonia.title: Estonia might have to return European Peace Facility sums over ammo procurement mess
estonia.description: It is not yet clear whether Estonia will have to repay the money it received from the European Peace Facility to purchase artillery shells for Ukraine, European Commission spokesperson Christian Wigand said.

estonia.title: New research: Bone deposits and plaque remember how ancient people lived
estonia.description: New technologies make it possible to extract useful information even from deposits accumulated on bones or from dental calculus. Molecules deposited on human remains can provide a more detailed picture of how the plague spread across Europe, according to a doctoral thesis defended at the University of Tartu.

estonia.title: Government to discuss new defense minister candidates next week
estonia.description: Prime Minister Kristen Michal has ruled out Reform Party Secretary General Kristo Enn Vaga as Estonia's next defense minister, saying the party will begin discussing candidates to replace Hanno Pevkur next week.

estonia.title: Urmas Paet: Russian frozen assets must be pressed into use to aid Ukraine
estonia.description: European Union countries must urgently return to the issue of utilizing Russian assets frozen following its invasion of Ukraine, writes MEP and European Parliament Committee for Foreign Affairs vice‑chair Urmas Paet (Reform).

estonia.title: Estonia's solar boom over
estonia.description: The future increasingly belongs to hybrid plants incorporating energy storage technology, Estonia's transmission system operator Elering said.

estonia.title: Center Party eyes no-confidence motion against prime minister
estonia.description: The opposition Center Party is approaching other parties on a potential no‑confidence motion against Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform).

estonia.title: RKIK head assumes responsibility: Agency failed to make sure contract reached audit office
estonia.description: Estonian Center for Defense Investments (RKIK) Director General Elmar Vaher took responsibility for the fact that the National Audit Office did not receive the contract for a €70 million artillery shell deal despite repeatedly requesting it.

estonia.title: LEIPZIGI JUHTUMI JÄREL ⟩ Berliin valmistab ette ulatuslikku Vene sabotaaži vastast plaani
estonia.description: Pärast augusti alguses Lepizigi-Halle lennujaamas toime pandud droonirünnaku katset, milles süüdistatakse Venemaad, plaanib Saksa valitsus tulevaste rünnakute eest kaitsmiseks tugevdada julgeolekumeetmeid.

estonia.title: ARVUSTUS ⟩ Kondiproov maailma kõige ohtlikuma mäe peal
estonia.description: 2022. aastal ilmunud põnevik «Kukkumine» osutus kõigi oma puuduste kiuste närvesöövaks žanrifilmiks, kus kaks raadiotorni tipus lõksu jäänud neidu panid alla maapinna suunas vaadates proovile ühe kõige levinuma hirmu: kõrgusekartuse. Kinodesse tulnud järg «Kukkumine 2» üritab sama efekti tekitada Tais asuva väljamõeldud mäega, ent teadupärast ei suuda isegi vilunud mustkunstnik sama trikiga teisel korral vaimustada – ja oleme ausad, raadiotorn keset kõrbe oli lihtsalt palju ägedam ja sümboolsem tegevuskoht.

estonia.title: Debütant Eliis Paas mahtus pararatturite MMil esikümnesse
estonia.description: Ameerika Ühendriikides Huntsvilles jätkunud pararatturite maailmameistrivõistlustel pälvis Eliis Paas temposõidus C2 klassis üheksanda koha. Mari-Liis Juul (C5) ja Anre Nõmme (C4) said omades klassides 16. koha.

estonia.title: PEETER ESPAK ⟩ Eesti mainekahju parandamiseks on kaks võimalust: kas sulid kinni võtta või lollid kohe lahti lasta
estonia.description: Ajaleht the Telegraph identifitseeris toimunu oma uudispealkirja reklaamis täpselt - ehk Eestis toimunu näol oli tegu relvatehingu pettusega (scam), kirjutab orientalist Peeter Espak.

estonia.title: Harry kodumaale naasmise põhjus tuli ilmsiks: prints valmistab ette dokumentaalfilmi oma emast, kuid üks küsimus varjutab kogu projekti
estonia.description: Prints Harry on väidetavalt asunud ellu viima väga isiklikku plaani, mis võib Briti kuningakojas taas vanad haavad lahti rebida. Sussexi hertsog soovib tuua ekraanile oma nägemuse printsess Diana elust ja pärandist, kuid läheneva 30. surma-aastapäeva eel ähvardab projekt süvendada niigi teravat vastasseisu tema ja prints Williami vahel, vahendab Hola!.

estonia.title: OTSE POSTIMEHEST ⟩ Kas on võimalik teha eelarve, mida opositsioon kohe põhja ei lase? Stuudios on Mart Võrklaev
estonia.description: Valitsus paneb praegu kokku eelarvet, mille vastuvõtmiseks tal endal hääli ei ole. Kas on võimalik teha selline eelarve, mis meeldiks ka opositsioonile, sellest räägime Postimehe otsesaates rahanduskomisjoni liikme Mart Võrklaevaga(RE).

estonia.title: HENRY KUNINGAS ⟩ Kuidas tsemendist sai eterniit ja kuidas kundalased jälle rohelisi puid näha said
estonia.description: Eestis on veel küllalt inimesi, kes on Kundat oma silmaga näinud või vähemalt kuulnud tondijutte peene halli tolmuga kaetud Virumaa linnast. Täna on Kunda jälle üks Virumaa rohelisemaid linnu, kaunile paeastangule kalarikka jõe äärde rajatud tsemenditööstuse mitmekesine pärand kuulub aga Eesti kõige suurejoonelisema ja põnevama tööstusarhitektuuri hulka, kirjutab arhitektuuriajaloolane ja muinsuskaitsja Henry Kuningas.

estonia.title: Rumeenia võimud süüdistavad Miami kinnimajas istuvaid Tate’i-vendi seksuaalkuritegudes
estonia.description: Rumeenia prokuratuur esitas sisuloojatest vendadele Andrew ja Tristan Tate’ile mitmeid süüdistusi seksuaalkuritegudes ja inimkaubanduses.

estonia.title: KLÕPSUD ⟩ «Mis toimub Trumpi juustega?» USA presidendi uus värvitud soeng tekitas internetis hämmeldust
estonia.description: USA presidendi Donald Trumpi värske välimus on pannud sotsiaalmeedia kihama. Reedel New Jerseys Morristownis lennukist Air Force One väljunud Trumpi juuksed paistsid tavapärase blondi tooni asemel märksa tumedamad ja pruunikamad, vahendab Independent.

estonia.title: Andrus Värniku kunagine mänedžer: öeldakse, et Andrus ei ole normaalne, aga tippsportlane ei saagi olla päris normaalne
estonia.description: Odaviske maailmameistri Andrus Värniku kunagine mänedžer Aivar Karotamm meenutas, kuidas kukkus eestlaste sangar madalseisu ning rääkis, mis on temast nüüd saanud.

estonia.title: LOODUSFOTO ⟩ Ilveste käitumine on muutunud
estonia.description: Ehkki olen pea kogu oma elu tegusa osa mööda saatnud looduses, olin kuni 2022. aastani ilvest näinud vaid mõne korra, sealt edasi aga igal aastal, kirjutab bioloog ja loodusfotograaf Rein Kuresoo.

estonia.title: New Yorgi koolidesse tuleb tehisarukeeld – kuni 8. klassini!
estonia.description: New York kehtestab eelseisval õppeaastal oma avalikes koolides kuni 8. klassi õpilastele üheaastase generatiivse tehisaru kasutamise keelu. Keelu eesmärk on kaitsta nooremaid lapsi tehnoloogia liigse ja ebasobiva kasutamise eest, samal ajal kui vanematele õpilastele hakatakse õpetama tehisaru kriitilist kirjaoskust.

estonia.title: FOTOD JA VIDEO ⟩ Endine Leedu president tegi Jõhvi publiku rõõmuks peadpööritavaid trikke
estonia.description: Kui keegi oleks reede õhtul Jõhvi kultuuri- ja huvikeskuse inimeste käest küsinud, et kuidas teil laupäeval toimuva Jõhvi lennupäeva korraldamine läheb, siis oleks vastus olnud üsna morbiidne. Poole päeva jagu tunde hiljem oli olukord sootuks rõõmsam ning rahvamass nautis lennumasinate peadpööritavaid trikke.

estonia.title: TAGASI KÜLMALE MAALE ⟩ Nelikümmend aastat Eestile närvidele käimist
estonia.description: 9. oktoobril esinevad Tallinna Kinomajas kolm Eesti punkbändi. J,M,K.E., Nyrok City ja Tuvipoeg. Vähemalt nii seisab kontserdi tutvustuses. Nyrok City vokalist Peeter Männiksoo ehk Minipets täpsustab siiski, et tema ei ole punkar. Seejärel keeldub ta küsimustele vastamast, kuni küsija õpib sõna «punk» õigesti hääldama.

latvia.title: Trump brushes off accusations of Russian sabotage against NATO allies
latvia.description: President Donald Trump dodged a chance Friday to condemn President Vladimir Putin over allegations that Russia has conducted espionage attacks on NATO nations. Trump, speaking to reporters at the White House, brushed off a question about one such apparent incident — the discovery of explosive-laden drones Aug. 4 at the Leipzig airport in Germany that officials have linked to Russia.

latvia.title: Valami készül Moszkva és Kijev között, Putyin háromórás tárgyalása után azonnal útnak indultak az amerikaiak - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index vasárnapi hírösszefoglalója
latvia.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index vasárnapi hírösszefoglalója.

latvia.title: NATO se pregătește să vâneze submarinele nucleare rusești fără SUA. Exercițiu militar în apropierea Islandei
latvia.description: Forțele aliate s-au adunat în apropierea Islandei pentru a exersa vânătoarea de submarine rusești, în absența unui membru cheie, scrie Politico. Distanțarea lui Donald Trump față de NATO s-a concretizat luna trecută în apele din largul Islandei.

latvia.title: SUA avertizează că NATO nu va tolera atacurile hibride asupra statelor membre, după incidentele recente atribuite Rusiei
latvia.description: Incidentul cu drone de la aeroportul Leipzig/Halle, pe care Germania l-a atribuit Rusiei, reprezintă un semnal de alarmă pentru NATO. Alianța trebuie să răspundă ferm acțiunilor hibride deliberate, iar Statele Unite vor sprijini țările vizate, a avertizat ambasadorul american la NATO, Matthew Whitaker.

latvia.title: Europa nu ar putea face față unui război de uzură cu Rusia, cred oficialii din domeniul apărării. „Se află într-o perioadă de stagnare”
latvia.description: Planificatorii din domeniul apărării care colaborează cu NATO se tem că, în cazul izbucnirii unui război cu Rusia, Europa nu ar putea face față în prezent unui război de uzură prelungit, din cauza lipsei de pregătire pentru război a populației, s-a afirmat săptămâna aceasta în cadrul unei conferințe dedicate viitorului coordonării militare europene, relatează The Guardian.

latvia.title: Exercițiu de război: Rusia atacă Republica Moldova, iar o dronă lovește un depozit de combustibil din România. Cum vor reacționa SUA?
latvia.description: Un exerciţiu de simulare desfăşurat luni în Statele Unite, cu participarea unor actuali membri ai Congresului şi foşti oficiali militari, diplomaţi şi ai serviciilor de informaţii, a analizat un scenariu în care Rusia atacă Republica Moldova în 2028, iar o dronă loveşte un depozit de combustibil din România, stat membru NATO, provocând victime civile. Despre exerciţiu scrie editorialistul The Washington Post David Ignatius, scrie News.ro care citează ziua.md.

latvia.title: „Putin nu are intenţia de a ataca teritoriul NATO” dă asigurări Donald Trump, care spune că va vorbi cu liderul rus
latvia.description: Donald Trump a spus din nou vineri că liderul rus Vladimir Putin „nu are intenţia de a ataca” NATO, după ce Germania a acuzat Moscova că a trimis o dronă încărcată cu explozibili la începutul lunii august la aeroportul din Leipzig, relatează AFP.

latvia.title: Sabotajul rusesc în Europa: cât de aproape suntem de un incident ce poate declanșa criza NATO
latvia.description: Atacul eșuat al Rusiei cu drone asupra unui aeroport german a făcut parte dintr-un model periculos de escaladare care, potrivit experților și oficialilor, riscă să declanșeze o confruntare deschisă cu NATO, indiferent dacă Kremlinul dorește acest lucru sau nu, scrie The New York Times.

latvia.title: Cum au ajuns datele de publicitate online o armă împotriva trupelor SUA din Orientul Mijlociu. Măsura radicală a armatei
latvia.description: Oficialii armatei SUA afirmă că au dezactivat sistemele de urmărire pentru publicitate online (ad trackers, n.r) pe o serie de telefoane și computere, potrivit unor scrisori, publicate vineri de senatorul american Ron Wyden și declarațiilor oferite agenției Reuters, o evoluție care vine în urma unor rapoarte conform cărora datele de localizare disponibile pe piață au fost utilizate pentru a ținti forțele americane din Orientul Mijlociu.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, mesaj pentru Giorgia Meloni după ce guvernul italian a stabilit un record de longevitate
latvia.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a transmis, vineri, un mesaj pentru premierul italian Giorgia Meloni, după ce guvernul condus de aceasta a devenit cel mai longeviv din istoria Republicii Italiene. Acesta a felicitat-o pe Meloni și a subliniat relațiile strânse dintre România și Italia, precum și interesele comune ale celor două țări în cadrul Uniunii Europene și NATO. Mesajul șefului statului vine în contextul în care România nu are un Guvern de patru luni, după demiterea prin moțiune de cenzură a Cabintului Bolojan.

latvia.title: Ambasada Moscovei la București: „Ameninţarea la adresa României nu vine din Rusia, ci din respectarea directivelor NATO și UE”
latvia.description: Ambasada Rusiei la București a publicat vineri o declaraţie de presă în urma convocării ambasadorului Vladimir Lipaev la Ministerul de Externe, în care califică drept „absurde” acuzaţiile Germaniei privind implicarea Rusiei în incidentul cu dronă pe aeroportul din Leipzig. Reprezentanța diplomatică a Moscovei mai afirmă, de asemenea, că „ameninţarea la adresa securităţii României” nu vine din Rusia, ci din „respectarea nechibzuită a directivelor de politică externă a aripii agresive NATO și UE”.

latvia.title: Ambasadorul Gavin Buchan: „Oamenii înțeleg acum că securitatea Mării Negre este securitatea flancului estic al NATO”
latvia.description: Canada este tot mai apropiată de Europa, pentru că valorile comune se recunosc uşor în lumea care se transformă. Securitatea continentului european este de interes pentru canadieni, iar Marea Neagră, cel mai fierbinte punct de pe flancul estic, este zona care îi ţine atenţi. Ambasadorul Gavin Buchan şi-a încheiat misiunea diplomatică în România, dar nu înainte să dea, la emisiunea Pașaport Diplomatic, mai multe detalii despre ce urmează în relaţia România-Canada.

latvia.title: INTERVIU „Până acum am avut secete reci, astăzi avem secete fierbinți”. Cum au dezvăluit stejarii cel mai secetos an din ultimele opt secole
latvia.description: Un grup de cercetători români a reconstituit opt secole de climă în România folosind  inelele de creștere ale stejarilor, completate cu cronici vechi. Coordonatorul acestei cercetări, profesorul Cătălin-Constantin Roibu de la Universitate Ștefan cel Mare din Suceava, vorbește, într-un interviu pentru publicul HotNews, despre evenimentele climatice extreme ale ultimilor 800 de ani, descoperite după ce …

latvia.title: Russian-language bookstore raided by Latvian security service
latvia.description: The State Security Service (VDD) carried out criminal investigation operations on Thursday and during the night of Thursday to Friday at four premises in Rīga and the surrounding area linked to the “Mnogoknig” bookshop chain, which primarily sells books in the Russian language, the service confirmed to the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Myths and Misconceptions
latvia.description: With Latvia's next parliamentary elections due to take place on October 3rd, we can expect a significant increase in the number of column inches (if there is still such a thing as a column inch) dedicated to Latvian politics in the international press.

latvia.title: Latvian police make another cigarette smuggling bust
latvia.description: Latvian State Police said on September 4th that at the end of August, law enforcement officers from the Riga Regional Department detained a known illegal cigarette dealer in the Ziepniekkalns suburb of Rīga.

latvia.title: Latvian auto sprint round postponed due to weather
latvia.description: Due to adverse weather conditions, the Latvian auto sprint round in Talsi has been postponed until next Saturday, 12 September, the organisers have announced.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: White Night, Homo Novus, Chris Noah
latvia.description: Although it is technically autumn (and it sure looks like it), there are still plenty of festivals and festivities to take part in!

latvia.title: Autumn exhibition season upcoming at Rothko Museum
latvia.description: On Friday, 11 September, the Rothko Museum in Daugavpils will open its Autumn exhibition season, bringing together artists of different generations from France, Italy and Latvia.

latvia.title: Riga IFF reveals short film programme
latvia.description: The Riga International Film Festival (Riga IFF), which will run from 15–25 October has announced its Short Film Competition programme.

latvia.title: No swimming in Lake Saldus due to bacterial presence
latvia.description: The results of an additional sample taken from Lake Saldus on 31 August have once again shown elevated levels of microbiological (E. coli) contamination in the bathing water, said the Health Inspectorate.

latvia.title: School equipment charity drive helps hard-pressed families
latvia.description: The charity campaign “Let’s Help Prepare for School Together!”, organised by the Akropole shopping malls and the charity organisation Ziedot.lv, has concluded after taking place for the seventh consecutive year.

latvia.title: Heavy rain alert Friday in northern, western Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, a yellow alert for heavy rain and thunderstorms is in force across Kurzeme and much of Vidzeme, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Latvia to spend EUR 28 million on land mines
latvia.description: Latvia plans to allocate 28.3 million euros to purchase mines this year and over the next two years, the LETA news agency reported on September 3.

latvia.title: Rēzekne spa centre finds tenant after over 20 auctions
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, the oral auction for the leasehold rights to the Rēzekne recreation or spa centre came to a close. A tenant has finally been found for the property, which the local authority had been seeking for some time, according to the Rēzekne City Council.

latvia.title: Rīga Airport begins terminal expansion
latvia.description: Rīga Airport is preparing for major changes – the passenger facilities will be expanded and equipped with new technology, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: airBaltic plans to get loan of 257 million euros
latvia.description: The Latvian airline ‘airBaltic’ has reached an agreement with investors on a loan of up to 257 million euros. The aim of the financing is to strengthen the company’s liquidity and secure the financial resources required to implement its new business plan. The interest rate has been set at 25 per cent per year, Latvian Television reported on September 3.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Another hack in Latvia, more public data leaked
latvia.description: Another official database in Latvia has been raided by hackers, it emerged on September 3rd.

latvia.title: One killed in three-car crash near Ikšķile, Latvia
latvia.description: One person was killed and two others were injured in a three-vehicle collision on the Daugavpils road between Ikšķile and Ogre on Thursday, the State Police told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Belarus conference to take place in Rīga
latvia.description: On Friday, 4th September from 10.00 to 13.30, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will host an international conference titled 'Conference on Belarus 2026'. The event is organised jointly by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Latvian Institute of International Affairs.

latvia.title: Latvia and Canada pool resources on Nepal disaster
latvia.description: Latvia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs provided another update on September 3rd on the status of dozens of Latvian citizens believed to be missing in Nepal following a catastrophic flood.

latvia.title: Saeima tightens up Latvia's e-identity laws
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 3rd, the Saeima supported amendments to the Law on Personal Identification Documents and amendments to the Law on Electronic Identification of Natural Persons in their final reading.

latvia.title: No more 'veggie sausages' as of 2029 in Latvia
latvia.description: On 18 August this year, a European Union (EU) regulation came into force stipulating that terms commonly used in the meat sector, such as “meat”, “bacon”, “steak” or “fillet”, may no longer be used for plant-based and other alternative products, the Ministry of Agriculture (ZM) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Dombrava, Kozlovskis survive no confidence vote in Latvian parliament
latvia.description: On Thursday, 3 September, Jānis Dombrava, Minister for the Interior (National Alliance), and Rihards Kozlovskis, Minister for Transport (New Unity), survived a vote of no confidence tabled by the opposition party Latvia First and several MPs not affiliated with any parliamentary group.

latvia.title: Insolvency fraud case under investigation in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police have completed a pre-trial investigation into alleged fraud in the provision of insolvency services, in which 57 people have been recognised as victims. The total loss amounts to at least 81,304 euros, the police said on September 3.

latvia.title: Latvia's Groglass to be sold to America's Apogee Enterprises
latvia.description: Latvian high-tech company Groglass, which develops and manufactures anti-reflective glass coatings, is being bought by US company Apogee Enterprises, it was announced on September 3rd.

latvia.title: NATO will be projecting oak in Latvia over next two weeks
latvia.description: From September 5th to 14th, the NATO Multinational Brigade in Latvia will be conducting drills with the name "Oak Projection" at the Sēlija military training ground.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: One month to go timeline
latvia.description: With exactly one month until polling day for Latvia's 15th Saeima elections on October 3rd, here's a rundown of a few important dates and deadlines over the next four weeks.

latvia.title: Dahlia paradise coming to Latvian Nature Museum
latvia.description: From 10 to 13 September, the Latvian National Museum of Natural History will host the exhibition “Dahlias 2026”, featuring hundreds of dahlias – including both classic varieties that have become favourites over the years and new breeds, the museum announced.

latvia.title: President meets Pope
latvia.description: President of Latvia Edgars Rinkēvičs is visiting the Vatican on 3-4 September.

latvia.title: Around 60 reports on possible election campaign breaches filed in Latvia
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) has so far received around 60 complaints regarding possible pre-election campaign violations. These have been confirmed in at least four cases, Latvian Radio reported on September 2.

latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: Facts & Figures

latvia.title: Alūksne hospital helps local farmers get rid of surplus produce
latvia.description: 'Kabaci vajag?' or 'Fancy a courgette?' is one of the most typical questions asked at harvest time, when there’s a bumper crop in your own and your neighbours’ gardens – and the same is true right now of tomatoes and other garden produce. This prompted staff at Alūksne Hospital to reach out to residents, farmers and home producers, asking them to share their surplus produce and make donations so that the patients’ menu could be expanded, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Man arrested for sexual abuse of minors in Latvia
latvia.description: A man born in 1967 has been arrested in Jelgava on suspicion of sexually abusing five minors, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Jelgava prison becomes tourist attraction
latvia.description: Jelgava Prison, which is more than 150 years old, ceased operations this summer, but its doors are now wide open to visitors. Guided tours allow visitors to see areas that were inaccessible to the public just a few months ago, Zemgale Regional Television reported on September 2.

latvia.title: Latvia congratulates the next President of Estonia

latvia.title: No honour guards at Freedom Monument this week in Latvia
latvia.description: During the first week of September, the ceremonial guard posts at the Freedom Monument and Rīga Castle will remain unmanned – this is due to military exercises.

latvia.title: Latvian average salary was 1,886 euros in second quarter
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data published on September 2 show that in Q2 2026 the average monthly gross wages and salaries stood at 1,886 euro (in full-time units). latvia.title: Latvian Saeima elections 2026: How the election works
latvia.description: October 3rd is another election day in Latvia. latvia.title: Fewer destinations for Latvia's airBaltic next summer season
latvia.description: Latvia’s national airline, “airBaltic”, will offer 55 direct routes from Rīga throughout the 2027 summer season, which is fewer than during this year’s summer season, according to calculations by the LETA news agency based on information provided by airBaltic.

latvia.title: Zaube Wild Food Festival celebrates 10 years this weekend
latvia.description: On 5th September, the Zaube Wild Food Festival will celebrate its 10th anniversary. lithuania.title: Europa nu ar putea face față unui război de uzură cu Rusia, cred oficialii din domeniul apărării. „Se află într-o perioadă de stagnare”
lithuania.description: Planificatorii din domeniul apărării care colaborează cu NATO se tem că, în cazul izbucnirii unui război cu Rusia, Europa nu ar putea face față în prezent unui război de uzură prelungit, din cauza lipsei de pregătire pentru război a populației, s-a afirmat săptămâna aceasta în cadrul unei conferințe dedicate viitorului coordonării militare europene, relatează The Guardian.

lithuania.title: Exercițiu de război: Rusia atacă Republica Moldova, iar o dronă lovește un depozit de combustibil din România. Cum vor reacționa SUA?

Despre exerciţiu scrie editorialistul The Washington Post David Ignatius, scrie News.ro care citează ziua.md.

lithuania.title: „Putin nu are intenţia de a ataca teritoriul NATO” dă asigurări Donald Trump, care spune că va vorbi cu liderul rus

lithuania.title: Sabotajul rusesc în Europa: cât de aproape suntem de un incident ce poate declanșa criza NATO

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, mesaj pentru Giorgia Meloni după ce guvernul italian a stabilit un record de longevitate
lithuania.description: Președintele Nicușor Dan a transmis, vineri, un mesaj pentru premierul italian Giorgia Meloni, după ce guvernul condus de aceasta a devenit cel mai longeviv din istoria Republicii Italiene. Acesta a felicitat-o pe Meloni și a subliniat relațiile strânse dintre România și Italia, precum și interesele comune ale celor două țări în cadrul Uniunii Europene și NATO. Mesajul șefului statului vine în contextul în care România nu are un Guvern de patru luni, după demiterea prin moțiune de cenzură a Cabintului Bolojan.

lithuania.title: Ambasada Moscovei la București: „Ameninţarea la adresa României nu vine din Rusia, ci din respectarea directivelor NATO și UE”

Reprezentanța diplomatică a Moscovei mai afirmă, de asemenea, că „ameninţarea la adresa securităţii României” nu vine din Rusia, ci din „respectarea nechibzuită a directivelor de politică externă a aripii agresive NATO și UE”.

lithuania.title: Ambasadorul Gavin Buchan: „Oamenii înțeleg acum că securitatea Mării Negre este securitatea flancului estic al NATO”

lithuania.title: Lietuva mirko lietuje: atskleidė, kur prilijo pusė mėnesio normos
lithuania.description: Šeštadienį daug kur šalyje lijo, o kai kuriose Lietuvos vietos lietaus norma viršijo pusės mėnesio normą, skelbia Lietuvos hidrometeorologijos tarnyba.

lithuania.title: Buvęs britų žvalgybos vadovas – apie rimtas Rusijos ir Ukrainos derybas: įvardijo, ko galima tikėtis
lithuania.description: JAV pasiuntiniai Steve'as Witkoffas ir Jaredas Kushneris sekmadienį žada atvyksti į Kyjivą susitikti su Ukrainos prezidentu Volodymyru Zelenskiu. Dieną prieš tai Maskvoje jie daugiau nei tris valandas kalbėjosi su Vladimiru Putinu. Baltųjų rūmų teigimu pasiuntiniai aptars konkrečius planus, kaip užbaigti karą. Tačiau buvęs Didžiosios Britanijos žvalgybos MI6 vadovas Johnas Sawersas į greitos taikos perspektyvą žvelgia pesimistiškai: jo vertinimu, rimtos derybos gali prasidėti tik 2027 metų pavasarį.

lithuania.title: Kretingos rajone neliko kelio – upelis viską išplovė: įspūdingas vaizdas
lithuania.description: Kretingos rajone neliko vieno kelio – po lietaus jis išplautas. Apie tai feisbuke skelbia seniūnija ir gyventojai.

lithuania.title: Vaikų dienos centrai prašo daugiau pinigų: Inga Ruginienė kalba, kad bus „sunku“
lithuania.description: Vaikų dienos centrams prašant kitąmet beveik dvigubai didinti finansavimą, socialinės apsaugos ir darbo ministrė Inga Ruginienė sako, kad rasti papildomų lėšų bus sudėtinga.

lithuania.title: Sigitas Tamkevičius. Sekmadenio Evangelija. „Meilė – įstatymo pilnatvė“
lithuania.description: Anuo metu Jėzus pasakė savo mokiniams: „Jei tavo brolis tau nusikalstų, eik ir bark jį prie keturių akių. Jeigu jis paklausys, tu laimėjai savo brolį. O jei nepaklausytų, pasiimk su savimi dar vieną ar du, kad visa byla remtųsi dviejų ar trijų liudytojų parodymais. Jeigu jis ir jų nepaklausytų, pranešk Bažnyčiai. O jei nepaklus nė Bažnyčiai, tebūnie jis tau kaip pagonis ir muitininkas.

lithuania.title: Vokietijos rytinė žemė renka vietos vyriausybę, apklausose pirmaujant AfD
lithuania.description: Rytų Vokietijoje esančioje Saksonijos-Anhalto žemėje sekmadienį 8 val. vietos (9 val. Lietuvos) laiku duris atvėrė rinkimų apylinkės regioniniuose rinkimuose, kuriuose aiškiai favoritė yra kraštutinių dešiniųjų partija „Alternatyva Vokietijai“ (AfD), galinti pirmą kartą suformuoti žemės vyriausybę.

lithuania.title: Iranas atsakė į JAV smūgius naftos tanklaiviams
lithuania.description: Iranas sekmadienį pranešė, kad jo pajėgos užpuolė JAV karinio jūrų laivyno droną, bandžiusį įplaukti į Hormuzo sąsiaurį, po to, kai atakavo laivus, atsakydamos į amerikiečių smūgius trims naftos tanklaiviams.

lithuania.title: Po dronų atakos dūmuose skendo viena didžiausių Rusijos naftos gamyklų
lithuania.description: Naktį Ukrainos dronai vėl smogė Rusijos Riazanės naftos perdirbimo gamyklai. Po smūgio ten kilo gaisras. Sprogimai buvo girdimi ir Rostove, kur, kaip praneša stebėjimo kanalas „Exilenova+“, buvo aktyvuotos oro gynybos sistemos.

lithuania.title: Martynas Katelynas atskleidė, ko imamasi atsakant į hibridines grėsmes
lithuania.description: Daugėjant pranešimų apie galimus sabotažo atvejus Europoje, Baltijos jūros regiono valstybės sutarė operatyviau keistis informacija ir koordinuoti veiksmus, sako vidaus reikalų ministras Martynas Katelynas.

lithuania.title: Vilniuje automobilyje apiplėštas vyras
lithuania.description: Sostinės Gabijos gatvėje apiplėštas automobilyje buvęs vyras, sekmadienį pranešė Vilniaus apskrities policija.

lithuania.title: JAV pasiuntiniai su Vladimiru Putinu aptarė planus Ukrainai
lithuania.description: JAV pasiuntiniai per susitikimą su Rusijos prezidentu Vladimiru Putinu aptarė „esminius planus“ dėl tolesnių žingsnių karui Ukrainoje užbaigti, pranešė Baltieji rūmai.

lithuania.title: Šiauliuose rastas vyro kūnas, Molėtų rajone – žmogaus kaulai
lithuania.description: Šiauliuose ir Molėtų rajone rasti dviejų žmonių palaikai, sekmadienį pranešė policija.

lithuania.title: „Reuters“ šaltiniai atskleidė Putino šių metų tikslą Ukrainoje
lithuania.description: Rusijos lyderis Vladimiras Putinas vis dar ketina užimti visą Donbaso teritoriją. Pasak „Reuters“, jis mano, kad šį tikslą galima pasiekti iki šių metų pabaigos.
